guide.description: Two lines of maths, repeated millions of times, drawn as silk. The four knobs are the four letters in the formula.

controls.action: The four knobs are a, b, c and d in the formula. Turn one and the whole figure bends.
The show on or off. On, the figure performs by itself with the music. Off, it rests where you leave it and sharpens as the points gather.
Player: music, microphone or line in, or silence; the piece; the show.
Any knob: switch it between fine steps (0.01) and coarse steps (0.10).
Open Menu for Guide, audio, Reload or Exit.
Next preset. The letters glide there, so you see the figure change.
Next formula, at its first preset.
Player. E1 moves through the choices, a press of E1 takes one, K4 closes.
Show or hide the formula, the letters and the number of points.
Set it spinning. Drag to stop.
Mute or unmute the music, with a short fade. With the microphone or Silent, play the music.

sections.title: The show
sections.text: The App opens in the show. The figure turns and tilts, its letters sway, and the sound moves them. Where the music changes, the letters slide to the next figure of the formula; after three figures the show moves on to the next formula and colours. Turn a knob and the show leaves the figure to you for a while. On a large output the figure slowly grows past the edges and comes back. Hold K3 to stop: the figure stays as it is, rests and sharpens. A shared link opens its one figure at rest.

sections.title: The picture
sections.text: Each formula takes a point and gives the next one. The App follows many points at once and counts where they land: the more often a place is hit, the brighter it is. Every figure has depth: for a two-line formula it is where each point was one step before. A three-line formula moves smoothly through space and is drawn as one long line wound into its figure. While anything moves the figure is a little grainy; at rest the points gather to several million and the picture becomes smooth, then stops. Some settings collapse to a few points, which the device screen says; K2 always leads back to a preset. A large output shows the figure only, with no text.

sections.title: Sound
sections.text: Music plays the two pieces that come with the App, Strange Loop and Sacred Orbit, in turn. The figure follows them from the first moment; where a browser allows sound only after a touch or a key, the sound joins then. Muted, the music plays on unheard and the figure keeps time. Mic / Line in follows the audio input instead, which is never played back or kept. Silent leaves the figure alone. The low, middle and high parts of the sound sway a, b and c, and sudden swells nudge d. Choose inputs and outputs and set levels in Menu.

sections.title: Saved settings
sections.text: The formula, a, b, c and d, the colours, the view, the show, the sound, the piece, whether it is muted and whether the text shows save automatically. A shared link opens the same figure from the same side.
